citations.assessment: The exact passage explicitly names R. Yehudah bar Simon as transmitter and Levi son of Tarfon as authority.
The Leviticus parallel gives the closely related image of weakening the Creator’s strength and transmits it in the name of Levi ben Perata.
The cited lemma gives Levi ben Perata in the queen-and-fuel parable with the same transmitter.
The checked Eikhah has Levi bar Perata in the palace-fire parable, where Heilprin gives ben Palta.

notes.text: The exact passage explicitly names R. Yehudah bar Simon as transmitter and Levi son of Tarfon as authority.
The Leviticus parallel gives the closely related image of weakening the Creator’s strength and transmits it in the name of Levi ben Perata.
The cited lemma gives Levi ben Perata in the queen-and-fuel parable with the same transmitter.

Preserve the printed variant Palta and the different words before it. Direct digital witnesses have Perata and do not establish identity with the first heading.
